description: This is an abstract Java class 'TaskProcessor' that manages processing of tasks within a queue system, including message handling, task execution, cancellation, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: TaskProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class for processing tasks from a queue, handling message processing, task execution, cancellation, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the task consumer and related components after construction.

methods.name: onPartitionChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles partition change events to update the consumer partitions.

methods.name: onComponentLifecycle
methods.description: Handles lifecycle events for jobs and tenants, updating internal state and cancelling tasks as needed.

methods.name: processMsgs
methods.description: Processes a batch of messages from the queue, filtering and processing tasks accordingly.

methods.name: processTask
methods.description: Executes a task asynchronously, handles timeouts, retries, and reports results.

methods.name: reportTaskFailure
methods.description: Reports a task failure with an exception.

methods.name: reportTaskResult
methods.description: Reports the result of a task to the stats service.

methods.name: addToDiscarded
methods.description: Adds a task key to the discarded set.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a future to complete, handling interruption.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops the consumer and executor service.

methods.name: cancelRunningTasks
methods.description: Cancels running tasks based on key or tenant ID.
